text.en:
Adjustment of Dividend Rate. Pursuant to Section 5 of RA No.
7656, the percentage of net earnings to be declared and remitted by the DBP to the
THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES

National Government for CYs 2018, 2019 and 2020 is adjusted from fifty percent
(50%) of its annual net earnings to 0%.

Coverage. The adjusted dividend rate set forth in Section 1 of this
Order is applicable only to the DBP for CYs 2018, 2019 and 2020.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 29t day of December
year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty-One.
By the President
- 48
SALVADOR C. MEDIALDEA
Executive Secretary V
REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES
Ofice of the Presiderot
MALACAÑANG RECORDS OFFICE
ATTY. CONCERCION
191-17-2022
ME. TENSORE LAG ERAD
DIRECTOR. IV
